issues.description: The solution implementation defines Book.title with the wrong type (Int) while the problem statement requires title to be a String. This also contradicts the usage in the solution's client where Book is constructed with String titles. The mismatch prevents correct compilation and confuses students about the expected type for Book.title.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the Book struct's title property type from Int to String in Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift so it matches the problem specification and the client usage (let title: String). Ensure all fields remain `let` constants as required.
